Production is natural and wide: hall reverb with a long decay tail, distant room mics, audible bow noise, ending on a sustained string chord fading to silence.

results.leomusic_sp: Gypsy jazz quartet featuring solo clarinet, acoustic rhythm guitar, upright bass, and accordion, recorded live in an empty hall. Woody pizzicato upright bass walks in steady quarter notes while the accordion breathes long legato pads and counter-melodies behind the beat. Solo clarinet leads: warm and low in the verses, bright improvised runs and flourishes over the turnarounds, with light vibrato and melodic slides. Warm female vocals, close-miked and intimate, slightly breathy, phrasing lazily behind the beat. Harmony is minor-key and restless, leaning on sweetly unresolved sevenths that slide a step downward before settling home. Swung feel in 4/4 time at 168 BPM in the key of G minor. Clean acoustic production, natural room reverb with a long empty-hall tail, warm analog tone. Nostalgic, wandering, bittersweet.
